name: McGill Friendship Questionnaire - Friendship Functions
instruction: Please rate how often your partner fulfills each friendship function (0 = Never, 1 = Rarely, 2 = Sometimes, 3 = Often, 4 = Very often, 5 = Always).

items.text: Is exciting to be with and brainstorms engaging activities.
Provides amusing banter and keeps our time lively.
Sparks engaging conversations on curious ideas.
Helps me acquire relevant information and tips.
Lends a hand when I need assistance with a task.
Shares useful resources whenever I face an obstacle.
Listens patiently to my innermost private confidences.
Keeps private the sensitive thoughts I disclose.
Encourages mutual emotional openness without judgment.
Can be trusted to stick by me even in tough times.
Is dependable and fulfills commitments made to me.
Maintains loyalty and consistent partnership over time.
Reassures me of my personal self-worth and talents.
Helps me feel valued as a capable individual.
Praises positive traits and thoughtful decisions I make.
Offers calming presence and comfort when I feel stressed.
Provides emotional safety so I never feel isolated.
Helps me restore peace of mind during anxious moments.
